description: UnionBest step 10 MMR cross-port golden pin (MMR-2). Read by Swift UnionBestMMRCrossPortFixtureTests.swift and Rust union_best_mmr_parity.rs. A full-hydration unionBest matrixAware recall at limit 3 over four near-duplicate bodies (the query plus one trailing word each) and eight diverse bodies that carry the query terms in different phrasing. The pool (12) exceeds the 2N working view (6), so the greedy MMR decides which candidates enter the view; the shingle term penalises the second, third and fourth near-duplicates out of it. expected_content_order was produced by the Swift build after COL-2 (similarity term scaled by the step 8.5 redistribution factor; locus column out of text-query scoring since COL-1) and is asserted verbatim by both ports. The pin before COL-1 was [query body, '... outage review', 'a deploy day ...']: the third slot moved because the locus recency rank no longer scores a text query (the two newest bodies had held slots 2 and 3), not because of the MMR; the near-duplicates stay out. The integrated COL-1 tree returned [query body, '... deploy today', '... deploy again'] (two near-duplicates admitted) and is the mutation control for the similarity scale.
